item.title: Plug 0.7.0
item.description:
• New Browse tab (⌘5): every product from 132 makers, grouped by maker, including Minimal Audio's whole line. On New and Deals, picking a maker adds a "Whole line" button.
  • iLok badge on products that need an iLok licence, and iLok License Manager opens from Plug like Native Access (Plug downloads PACE's installer if it's missing).
  • Sound previews: a play button on a card streams its demo inside Plug (Splice packs, Output presets, Ghost Syndicate, HY2ROGEN, Cr2). SoundCloud and YouTube demos open in the browser.
  • Updates tab shows which of your plug-ins your projects use: DAWs, project count and last used, with "least used first" and a "Never used" filter. Plug reads Logic, Live and REAPER projects, never changes them, and nothing leaves your Mac. While Plug is open it also notes the plug-ins your DAW loads (Settings › Use turns that off).
